'''Chaena''' is a warrior from [[Shienar]]. 

== Activities ==
He was one of the twenty Shienarans picked to accompany [[Ingtar Shinowa]] and [[Rand al'Thor]] on the hunt for the [[Horn of Valere]].

Along with the other Shienarans, he stayed around [[Masema Dagar]] when Masema became the Prophet.{{ref/book|5|38}}

Along with [[Uno Nomesta]], he took the [[Riverserpent]] downriver to [[Salidar]] and enrolled as part of the army of the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]]. By this time, there were only fifteen of the original twenty Shienarans left.{{Ref/book|5|40}}{{Ref/book|5|47}}

He presumably fought in the [[Last Battle]] among the forces of [[The White Tower]] as did Uno.
